//security_overrides: SECURITY: (1) uuid is pinned to ^11.1.1 inside vite-plugin-top-level-await only: the plugin's latest release (1.6.0) pins uuid@10.0.0, which has GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is passed). The plugin only calls v5(name, namespace) with no buffer, so it was not reachable, but 11.x keeps the same CommonJS v5 API; drop the override once the plugin bumps uuid. The same plugin does require(rollup) at load time and rebuilds worker chunks with it; vite 8 (rolldown) no longer brings rollup into the tree, so rollup ^4 is an explicit devDependency — without it `vite build` fails to load vite.config.ts (CI run 39653677151). Drop it once the plugin ships a rolldown-native release. (The old esbuild ^0.25 override existed only for vite 5; vite 8 takes esbuild ^0.27 || ^0.28 only as an optional peer, and the pin was forcing tsx below its own ~0.28 range.) (2) tar/brace-expansion are pinned to patched releases: tar<=7.5.20 has 6 open advisories incl. critical GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw (decompression DoS) and brace-expansion 3.0.0–5.0.8 has 3 high DoS advisories. Both enter only via @capacitor/cli, which still requires tar@^7.5.3 and rimraf@^6.0.1 (→glob→minimatch→brace-expansion) even at 8.5.0, and npm resolves those ranges to the vulnerable floors. The overrides force the fixed floors inside the existing compatible ranges — no behavior change, no upgrade needed. Recheck after the next @capacitor/cli bump.
